investment_strategy: Aim to capture structural A.I. growth while controlling drawdowns in a mixed-risk macro (VIX ~20, 10Y ~4.23%, recent Nasdaq pullback). Build a core-satellite portfolio: core exposure in high-quality cloud/software platforms with durable moats and strong analyst support, plus a smaller satellite in critical A.I. silicon to participate in upside from data center capex. Position sizing reflects elevated but manageable volatility and rate sensitivity. Diversify across software and semiconductors; avoid concentration in highest-vol names. Implementation: stagger entries over 2–3 weeks to reduce timing risk; rebalance quarterly or on 5%+ weight drift. Risk controls: cap the single high-vol semiconductor position at 15%; if VIX > 25 or 10Y > 4.75%, trim the satellite allocation; if portfolio drawdown > 15%, reassess and reduce the highest-beta position. Key catalysts: enterprise A.I./copilot monetization, Azure/GCP growth, next-gen GPU launches, HBM supply ramps, power procurement deals. Key risks: antitrust/regulatory outcomes (search and A.I.), U.S.-China export controls, data center power constraints, and rate spikes.
